paired_cohort.definition: Intersection of both completed, explicitly unprofiled timing-eligible cohorts, retaining warmup0/save/I/O exclusions.

caveats: Both selected main runs naturally SUCCEEDED; failed Rubin A1 is separate and was not joined to A2.
Rubin is an engineering sample. A2 uses4096 training/logprob tokens per GPU; GB uses8192. Images/software differ.
Same rollout IDs align training progress, not generated sequence shapes or wall-clock conditions; these are observed system differences, not isolated GPU speedups.
Stage timers can overlap and are not an additive wall-time partition. Kernel-level attribution still awaits profiling.
Throughput is arithmetic mean/median of the recorded per-rollout output token/GPU/generation-second rates, not a ratio of globally accumulated totals.
Training reward is the pre-update batch score. Last10 includes all20480 responses from rollouts40–49, even if timing is excluded.
Held-out evaluation reuses the same256 GSM8K questions with stochastic sampling. Final247/256 vs246/256 is a one-question difference, not evidence of a reliable quality gap.
Logged aggregate gradient norm is verified for every optimizer update; four-rank NORMAL/valid records corroborate execution but are not independent per-rank gradient-norm measurements.
No historical VeRL result enters the current paired comparison.
